variables.name: Variables
questions: What value does this variable hold right after this line runs?

functions.name: Functions
questions: What goes in, and what comes out of this function?

conditionals.name: Conditionals
questions: Which inputs make this condition true? Which make it false?

loops.name: Loops
questions: How many times does this loop body run for an input of size 3?

arrays.name: Arrays and lists
questions: What is stored at each position of this list after the loop?

strings.name: Strings
questions: How is a string like a list of characters? Where do they differ?

array_indexing.name: Array indexing
questions: A list has 5 elements. What are the smallest and largest valid indexes?
Which index does your loop read on its very last iteration?

edge_cases.name: Edge cases
questions: What is the smallest input this function could receive? What does your code do with it?
What happens with empty input?

loop_invariants.name: Loop invariants
questions: What is true at the top of every iteration, before the body runs?
After the loop ends, what does that fact tell you about the answer?

iteration_safety.name: Safe iteration
questions: While you walk a list, what happens to the positions of the items after one you remove?

time_complexity.name: Time complexity
questions: If the input doubles, roughly what happens to the number of steps?

binary_search.name: Binary search
questions: What does each comparison let you throw away?

two_pointers.name: Two pointers
questions: What does moving each pointer rule out?

sliding_window.name: Sliding window
questions: When the window slides one step, what enters and what leaves?

base_cases.name: Base cases
questions: What is the smallest input for which you already know the answer?
Does every recursive call get closer to that input?

call_stack.name: The call stack
questions: When this call returns, where does execution continue?

recursion.name: Recursion
questions: How does the problem shrink with each call?

tree_traversal.name: Tree traversal
questions: When does the node get visited relative to its two subtrees?

pointers.name: Pointers and references
questions: If you overwrite this reference, can you still reach what it used to point to?

linked_lists.name: Linked lists
questions: What does the last node's next point to?

stacks.name: Stacks
questions: Which item leaves a stack first?

queues.name: Queues
questions: Which item leaves a queue first?

hash_maps.name: Hash maps
questions: What question about earlier items can a map answer in one step?

graphs.name: Graphs
questions: Which nodes can you reach in one step from this node?

bfs.name: Breadth-first search
questions: In what order are nodes discovered, and why does that give shortest paths?

dfs.name: Depth-first search
questions: How far does the search go before it backs up?

memoization.name: Memoization
questions: Which calls repeat the same work?

optimal_substructure.name: Optimal substructure
questions: Is the best answer built from best answers to smaller problems?

dp.name: Dynamic programming
questions: What is the smallest subproblem, and what does each larger one combine?

debugging_by_tracing.name: Debugging by tracing
questions: Write down the value of each variable after every line for one small input. Where does reality first differ from your expectation?

reading_error_messages.name: Reading error messages
questions: Which line does the message point at, and what does it say about that line?

requirements_analysis.name: Requirements analysis
questions: Who uses this and what must they be able to do? What is explicitly out of scope?

capacity_estimation.name: Capacity estimation
questions: How many requests per second at peak, and how many bytes does each one store?

data_modeling.name: Data modeling
questions: What is the main key you look records up by?

api_design.name: API design
questions: What does a client send, and what can come back when things go wrong?

caching.name: Caching
questions: Which reads repeat often enough to be worth remembering, and when does the copy go stale?

scaling.name: Scaling
questions: Which component hits its limit first as traffic grows ten times?

sharding.name: Sharding
questions: What key splits the data evenly, and what happens to a query that needs two shards?

replication.name: Replication
questions: If one copy dies, which copy serves the next request, and could it be behind?

bottlenecks.name: Bottlenecks
questions: If one key gets a thousand times more traffic than the rest, what breaks?

failure_handling.name: Failure handling
questions: What does the user see when this dependency is down?

tradeoffs.name: Trade-offs
questions: What did you give up by choosing this, and when would you choose differently?

id_generation.name: ID generation
questions: How do you guarantee two servers never hand out the same id?

rate_limiting.name: Rate limiting
questions: Where is the counter stored, and what happens at the boundary between two time windows?
